messages:
laura: Running into a weird one with redwoodctl when I'm testing locally against a k8s port-forwarded service — auth token refresh fails as soon as I toggle the port-forward. anyone seen this?

sam: hmm. what does the error look like?

laura: `Error: oauth refresh failed: network error: connection reset` right after the port-forward restarts. I repro by `kubectl port-forward svc/redwood-frontend 8080:80` then stop/start it. redwoodctl login works initially but subsequent calls 401.

arthur: does redwoodctl hit a different host when refreshing vs initial login? could be hostname resolution or a proxy/socket change.

laura: I traced it: initial login goes to `https://auth.localnet.internal` via the port-forward on 8080. refresh uses the same host but the TLS handshake sometimes fails because the port-forward closes and reopened on same local port quickly.

sam: is there a TCP TIME_WAIT or ephemeral socket reuse issue? any race in redwoodctl around connection pooling?

laura: stack trace snippet: ```
post /v1/auth/refresh  -> net/http: request canceled (client disconnected)
...
```

arthur: ok that's a client cancel. redwoodctl uses Go http.Client with a persistent transport. When the underlying connection is closed and the client reuses it, Go returns connection reset. We should retry on transient network error for refresh flows.

tess: fwiw, i ran into a similar flake when switching VPN + port-forward; workaround was to `export REDWOODCTL_NO_KEEPALIVE=1` (local hack) which forces new connections each request. not ideal.

laura: thanks — that helped confirm it's keepalive reuse. can we add an explicit retry with backoff for refresh token step?

sam: yes. i'll file an issue on eng-runtime to add a short retry loop (3 attempts, jittered) around the refresh call and mark it safe for idempotency. also add an env toggle `REDWOODCTL_AUTH_RETRY=3` so devs can opt-in while patch lands.

arthur: also add note in devex docs about port-forward + localnet gotchas and the `REDWOODCTL_NO_KEEPALIVE` workaround.

laura: created a minimal reproducer: `scripts/repro-auth-portforward.sh` — it does `kubectl port-forward` in a loop while running `redwoodctl api whoami` every 2s. I'll drop it in the ticket.

ci-bot: Issue created: INF-2892 "redwoodctl: retry on transient network errors during auth refresh (port-forward flakes)" assigned to @sam.

sam: i'll take it. quick patch + unit test for http retry behavior, and mention in changelog.

tess: can we also surface this in the onboarding checklist? local testing paragraph that mentions VPN/port-forward flakiness and env hacks. saves time for new hires.

laura: agreed — adding to the devex onboarding doc after patch merges. thanks y'all :thumbsup:

sam: follow-up: i pushed a draft PR that adds a retry decorator around the refresh request and exposes `--auth-retry` flag in `redwoodctl login`. leaving tests & docs for next commit. will ping when green.

laura: nice, will validate with my repro script once CI is green.

arthur: nice triage. low-risk fix and helpful doc updates.

laura: tagging this thread for future search: `port-forward`, `auth-refresh`, `redwoodctl`
